releases.name: SpecStream tools 1.2.0
releases.body:
Matches the MCP registry version (`ai.specstream/specstream` 1.2.0).

- Gemini CLI extension and GitHub Copilot plugin at 1.2.0
- Cline and other agents connect to the hosted server directly (`https://api.specstream.ai/mcp`, OAuth); the stdio proxy is the fallback (`llms-install.md`)
- Clients 1.1.0: `specstream-client` and `@specstream/sdk` wait 150 s for a request to be read
- Cursor plugin description updated
